headline: Gulshan OC withdrawn five days after AL procession
summary: Officer-in-Charge Md Daud Hossain has been attached to DMP headquarters following a banned Awami League procession in the area.
details: Gulshan Model Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md Daud Hossain was withdrawn and attached to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) headquarters today.
The move comes five days after activists of the banned Awami League brought out a procession in Dhaka’s Gulshan area.
DMP Commissioner Mosleh Uddin Ahmed signed the office order, which takes effect immediately.
DMP Deputy Commissioner (Media) Akter Hossain stated that the OC was attached to the Central Reserve Office and Administration Department for •administrative reasons–
The incident occurred on September 11, when around 150-200 activists of the Awami League and its affiliated organisations marched in Gulshan-1.

caption:
A Gulshan police chief is out after a banned political procession turned violent with crude bombs.

Gulshan Model Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md Daud Hossain was withdrawn and attached to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) headquarters today.

The move comes five days after activists of the banned Awami League brought out a procession in Dhaka’s Gulshan area.

DMP Commissioner Mosleh Uddin Ahmed signed the office order, which takes effect immediately.

DMP Deputy Commissioner (Media) Akter Hossain stated that the OC was attached to the Central Reserve Office and Administration Department for •administrative reasons–

The incident occurred on September 11, when around 150-200 activists of the Awami League and its affiliated organisations marched in Gulshan-1.

During the dispersal, police reported that two crude bombs were detonated and officers fired two rounds of rubber bullets to control the crowd.

Two individuals were arrested at the scene, and five unexploded crude bombs were recovered by police.

Source: Jamuna TV, The Daily Star

headline_marked: 2 arrested as [[teacher killed in snatching]] near Parliament
headline: 2 arrested as teacher killed in snatching near Parliament
summary: A headteacher was fatally injured after being pulled from a rickshaw by snatchers on a motorcycle. The DB has arrested two suspects and recovered the vehicle.
details: A headteacher was killed after being pulled from a rickshaw by snatchers on a motorcycle in front of the National Parliament building in Dhaka.
The victim fell from the rickshaw during the violent snatching attempt, which led to her death.
The Detective Branch (DB) of the police has arrested two suspects in connection with the incident.
Police have also recovered the motorcycle used by the criminals during the crime.
Despite the arrests, the DB has stated that they are continuing their investigation to capture the 'actual snatchers' involved in the incident.
caption:
A headteacher was killed after being pulled from a rickshaw by snatchers in front of the National Parliament.

A headteacher was killed after being pulled from a rickshaw by snatchers on a motorcycle in front of the National Parliament building in Dhaka.

The victim fell from the rickshaw during the violent snatching attempt, which led to her death.

The Detective Branch (DB) of the police has arrested two suspects in connection with the incident.

Police have also recovered the motorcycle used by the criminals during the crime.

Despite the arrests, the DB has stated that they are continuing their investigation to capture the 'actual snatchers' involved in the incident.
